This is a straightforward observation/navigation task where the agent must locate a cut red sandstone slab placed somewhere in the scene. It is visually distinctive (reddish-orange color with smooth cut texture), easily verifiable (agent needs to look at it), and doesn't require deep Minecraft crafting knowledge — just visual recognition and navigation. As a single task, no multi-hop dependency is needed, but it still requires the agent to explore and identify the correct block among potential distractors.

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate near the cut_red_sandstone_slab (placed at spawn-relative position [2, 1, 4] on top of a red sandstone pedestal) and face toward it, demonstrating they have identified and located the correct block among several similar-looking reddish distractors. max_distance=16 allows detection from reasonable range, facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the target.

scene_description: A flat grass platform with multiple clusters of reddish/orange blocks serving as distractors. The target cut_red_sandstone_slab is placed on a red_sandstone pedestal at (2, 1, 4) relative to spawn. Distractors include orange concrete pillar, red concrete, regular red sandstone, smooth red sandstone, red sandstone slab, sandstone variants, and red nether bricks - all testing visual discrimination of similar-colored blocks.
task_text: Find the cut red sandstone slab in the scene. It is a half-height block with distinctive horizontal band texture, placed somewhere among several similar-looking reddish and orange blocks.
design_notes: Target block (cut_red_sandstone_slab) is elevated on a pedestal at (2,1,4) to make its side texture visible. Distractors are grouped in 4 clusters: (1) red sandstone family near target at +X/+Z, (2) orange/red concrete pillar at -X/+Z, (3) regular sandstone at center/+Z, (4) red nether bricks at far -X/+Z. All clusters are within 8 blocks of spawn and visible from the initial spawn position. The pedestal elevation helps players see the distinctive horizontal band texture of the cut variant.
